New Hampshire ELP Proficiency Level Targets
Overview, Results & Considerations
Damian Betebenner & Adam VanIwaarden
Center for Assessment

July 31st, 2023

Overview
 • The following slides provide tables of WIDA-ACCESS pro ciency level targets for
 students based upon three criteria:

 • The grade cluster (1-3, 4-7, 8-12) associated with the student’s score (one table per
 slide)

 • The current year achievement level (1.0-1.9, 2.0-2.9, 3.0-3.9, 4.0-4.5) of the student
 • The time frame to reach pro ciency based upon number of years enrolled in school.
 In general: Years to Reach Target = 5 - Years Enrolled in School

 • Table values were derived from individual level SGP based English language
 pro ciency targets calculated across time frames ranging from 1 to 5 years.

Considerations
 • The pro ciency level targets
 • One shortcoming associated with targets aggregated by prior achievement level, years
 enrolled in school and grade cluster is that there is substantial heterogeneity within each
 group.

 • Students in grade cluster 4-8, starting at WIDA pro ciency level of 3.0 to 3.9 have a
 target of 3.8. Note that this target is inclusive of all students from 3.0 to 3.9

 • For students starting at 3.0 this target will be much more ambitious than for those at
 3.9

 • And alternative approach to using these summary targets is to use the individual level
 targets for students. This is the approach employed by Massachusetts
